verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs describe an MCP integration letting an AI assistant search documentation, inspect endpoint schemas, and execute live API requests directly in an editor, which functions as an interactive, runnable API reference for AI-native users (lithic-docs-1, lithic-docs-14, lithic-probe-3). However, there's no evidence of a traditional browser-based interactive reference (e.g., a 'try it' console or exposed OpenAPI spec — lithic-probe-2 shows all openapi.json candidates 404), so the experience is mediated only through the MCP/editor flow rather than a standalone reference page. Missing for 10: a documented in-browser interactive reference UI, an accessible OpenAPI/schema file, and independent/hands-on confirmation the MCP execution works reliably.
